column1: # Characters that are easy to mix up by sight. One group per line (characters, space-separated), then a tab and a short note.
# tools/build-confusers.py keeps only characters that are in an HSK 1-5 word and writes data/confusers.js.
# The app uses them for wrong answers on reading cards: two words of the same length that differ only in look-alike characters
# (买 / 卖, 他 / 她, 午 / 牛) are offered side by side, so the card tests the reading, not a guess.
# A line starting with ≠ names words that must never be options together (both could be right), e.g. 国画 is also a 图画.
